nodes.assessmentBasis: 原稿开头明确给出已知 vₙ→B，作为后续推理前提。
原稿由 vₙ→B 得到存在自然数 K，使所有 n≥K 都满足 |vₙ−B|<δ。
nodes.proofTerm:
by
  intro v_v v_B h v_delta h_use delta_pos
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp h_use) v_delta delta_pos
  exact ⟨K, fun n hn => by
    have hdist := hK n hn
    simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hdist⟩

由 K 所满足的性质和 n≥K 得到 |vₙ−B|<δ。
nodes.proofTerm:
by
  intro v_v v_B h v_delta K n K_prop n_ge_K
  exact K_prop n n_ge_K

by
  intro v_v v_B h v_delta K n
  exact congrArg abs (by ring : (v_v n + (3 : ℝ)) - (v_B + (3 : ℝ)) = v_v n - v_B)

nodes.assessmentBasis: 原稿把等式与 |vₙ−B|<δ 合起来写出 |(vₙ+3)−(B+3)|<δ。
nodes.proofTerm:
by
  intro v_v v_B h v_delta K n equality property
  rw [equality]
  exact property

nodes.assessmentBasis: 原稿断言对任意 n≥K 都有 |(vₙ+3)−(B+3)|<δ。
nodes.proofTerm:
by
  intro v_v v_B h v_delta K final_ineq K_prop n hn
  exact final_ineq v_v v_B h v_delta K n
    (congrArg abs (by ring : (v_v n + (3 : ℝ)) - (v_B + (3 : ℝ)) = v_v n - v_B))
    (K_prop n hn)

nodes.assessmentBasis: 原稿用同一个自然数 K 和所有 n≥K 的估计，给出变换后数列满足 δ 的极限判据。
nodes.proofTerm:
by
  intro v_v v_B h v_delta exists_K forall_n_prop
  obtain ⟨K, K_prop⟩ := exists_K
  refine ⟨K, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  exact forall_n_prop v_v v_B h v_delta K
    (fun v_v' v_B' h' v_delta' K' n' equality property => by
      rw [equality]
      exact property)
    K_prop n hn

nodes.assessmentBasis: 原稿最后根据数列极限的定义断言 vₙ+3→B+3。
nodes.proofTerm:
by
  intro v_v v_B h h_use exists_transformed
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
  intro delta delta_pos
  have exists_K : ∃ K, ∀ n, n ≥ K → abs (v_v n - v_B) < delta := by
    obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp h_use) delta delta_pos
    exact ⟨K, fun n hn => by
      have hdist := hK n hn
      simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hdist⟩
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := exists_transformed v_v v_B h_use delta exists_K
    (fun v_v' v_B' h' v_delta' K' final_ineq' K_prop' n' hn' =>
      final_ineq' v_v' v_B' h' v_delta' K' n'
        (congrArg abs (by ring : (v_v' n' + (3 : ℝ)) - (v_B' + (3 : ℝ)) = v_v' n' - v_B'))
        (K_prop' n' hn'))
  exact ⟨K, fun n hn => by
    have hdist := hK n hn
    simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hdist⟩

blocks.text: 设 (vₙ)ₙ∈ℕ 为实数数列，B 为实数，已知 vₙ→B。证明数列 (vₙ+3) 收敛到 B+3。原证明：任取 δ>0。由 vₙ→B，存在自然数 K，使所有 n≥K 都满足 |vₙ−B|<δ。对任意 n≥K，有 |(vₙ+3)−(B+3)|=|vₙ−B|<δ。因此根据数列极限的定义，vₙ+3→B+3。证毕。
